summary: Starry Sea Acquisition Corp, a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq (SSEA/SSEAU/SSEAR), filed an 8-K announcing postponement of its extraordinary general meeting in lieu of an annual general meeting from October 9, 2026 to 9:00 a.m. ET on October 19, 2026, to allow additional time to engage with shareholders. No change to location, record date, or proposals; the redemption deadline extends from October 7 to October 15, 2026. This is a US-equivalent EGM notice update. Watch redemption levels and whether engagement signals a contested or failed extension vote.
